response.answer: Before joining, require a protected verification window—ideally up to an hour with database access—for any statistics you may endorse, plus a clear rule that unverified figures are not presented as confirmed. Given the twice-daily cadence and peak scrutiny, also ask for written source records and an agreed correction/escalation process. This fits your preference for preparation in high-stakes work and addresses the cost you experienced when an unverified live statistic proved outdated.
